title: Paul M NDE 7857
content: Funny, I generally took my diving knife with me on these trips, but it was dull. So as I left my apartment, a utility blade just caught my eye, gabbed it, put it it in the pocket, but hardly gave it a thought. I was white water canoeing on the Delaware river in upstate New York. The canoe capsized, pinning me under the water. The canoe was wedged between two rocks and it upright itself full of water. I was underneath the canoe with two ropes wrapped around my leg. On the end of the ropes, there were a couple plastic bags pulling due to the current. Between the canoe filled with water and the position of the ropes I could not move. I was trapped under the water for over 3.5 minutes. As soon as the canoe flipped, I started to cough until there was no air left in my lungs. I felt a tremendous burning sensation. At this point, I was absolutely terrified. Water started to trickle down the back of my throat. At first it was terrifying, realizing I would soon drown. Then once I accept I would die, it started to feel great. At this point, the white light appeared. I felt I was moving towards it and was feeling better the closer I got to the light. It was very strange, I saw no one but felt as if I were surrounded by untold numbers of benevolent entities. I could feel their presence and all pleasant. The further I entered into the light, the more pleasant it got. The light had an emotional overtone to it. I have NEVER felt anything that felt as real as this in my life; never have I felt so at peace. I was at the verge of inhaling water, as it felt so good trickling down my throat; it really felt good. Then I remembered I had stuck a utility knife razor in the tiny pocket of my blue jean before leaving for the canoe trip. Then the terror came back, giving me enough adrenaline to reach down and cut the ropes on my leg. Once the ropes were cut, I could move. I came to the surface. I floated for 5 minutes, as I had no strength left.

arrival.other_being_detail: Felt surrounded by "untold numbers of benevolent entities" but "saw no one" and only felt their presence.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: White water canoeing accident; canoe capsized and pinned him under water with ropes around his leg (near-drowning).

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel described; during drowning he accepted death, then a white light appeared and he felt movement toward it and the presence of many benevolent entities; he then returned attention to his body to cut ropes and surface.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The pleasant sensation of water trickling down his throat as he was about to inhale, alongside the light/presence experience; the memory of a utility razor enabled physical self-rescue.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Then once I accept I would die, it started to feel great." "At this point, the white light appeared." "I saw no one but felt as if I were surrounded by untold numbers of benevolent entities." "I have NEVER felt anything that felt as real as this in my life; never have I felt so at peace."
